headline: Bank Indonesia and Government Prepare Export Retention and 100% Rupiah Conversion
summary: Bank Indonesia expects a mandatory retention policy for natural resource export earnings to boost forex reserves, as the government prepares a regulatory overhaul for up to 100 percent conversion into rupiah.

impacts.name: Indonesian Rupiah
impacts.why: Mandatory conversion of foreign currency export earnings to rupiah increases domestic currency demand and foreign reserves.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
